A minority stake in Eurowind Energy, a Danish company that develops, constructs and operates renewable-energy parks, has been sold to Blackstone Infrastructure.

After receiving the required regulatory approvals, Blackstone Infrastructure now holds a 24.7 percent stake in Eurowind Energy and has committed up to DKK 15 billion ($2.3 billion) to accelerate the company’s growth across Europe.

Blackstone’s joining as a long-term partner will give Eurowind Energy additional financial capacity to substantially increase the pace of its work. Specifically, Eurowind Energy said the investment will support its goal to become a leading pan-European independent power producer.
